title: Rotate signing keys through a key id header, not by redeploying
content:
**What**: Tokens carry a key id and the verifier holds the current and previous key.
**Why**: A rotation by redeploy invalidated every live session.
**Where**: src/auth/keys.py
**Learned**: Keep the previous key for as long as the longest token lifetime.

title: Order status webhooks arrive out of order
content:
**What**: The payment provider sends status events without ordering guarantees.
**Why**: A refunded order flipped back to paid when a late event arrived.
**Where**: src/webhooks/payment_status.py
**Learned**: Compare the event timestamp with the stored one and ignore older events.

title: Queue consumers acknowledge after the effect, not before
content:
**What**: Consumers used to acknowledge on receipt.
**Why**: A crash between acknowledgement and effect lost the job.
**Where**: src/jobs/consumer.py
**Learned**: Acknowledge after commit; the handler is already safe to run twice.

title: Bulk import validates the whole file before writing any row
content:
**What**: The importer parses and validates every row first and writes only if all pass.
**Why**: Half-imported files left customers with partial catalogs.
**Where**: src/import/bulk.py
**Learned**: Report all row errors at once, not only the first.

title: Slow query on the audit table fixed with a composite index
content:
**What**: Audit lookups by tenant and date scanned the table.
**Why**: The existing index covered only the date.
**Where**: migrations/0042_audit_index.sql
**Learned**: Put the equality column first in the composite index.
